title: Commutation of Variational Discretization and Optimal Control
statement: For general classes of variational integrators used to discretize controlled Euler–Lagrange systems and their optimal-control problems, determine whether discretization and optimization commute, i.e. whether the discrete adjoint and optimality conditions have the same approximation order as the variational state discretization.
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Control Theory: A Mathematical Perspective on Cyber-Physical Systems (2015), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2015/12, pp. 597--659](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2015/12)

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-21)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** Commutation of discretization and dualization is proved for symplectic Runge--Kutta and symplectic Galerkin subclasses, but remains open for general variational integrators.
